title: Law on Prosecution and Punishment of Bribery — Article 2
text: In this law, the following persons are regarded to be in charge of the public services: a) Civil servants and the employees of the State and public corporations; b) Judges and members of the Provincial Council, Municipalities, counselors of the Municipalities, members of the Chamber of Commerce and other civil servants and employees of the public institutions; c) Members of the government, members of Parliament, members of the Supreme Court and their Presidents; d) Political and commercial representatives of Afghanistan abroad; and e) Defense Counsel, arbitrators, those who give the courts professional advice, and other persons who certify facts and their certificates are regarded valuable.
